generated.as: case when owner_user_id is null then 'system' else 'user' end
not is_hidden and (health = 'ready' or (owner_user_id is null and health = 'installing'))
not is_uninstalled and plugin_status = 'active' and (owner_user_id is null or owner_user_id = user_id)
case when owner_user_id is null then environment_config_revision_id else installation_config_revision_id end

coalesce(not is_hidden and health = 'ready' and case when owner_user_id is null then environment_config_is_usable else installation_config_plugin_revision_id = active_revision_id and installation_config_is_usable end, false)

ddl.name: entity_external_identity_unique

columns.value: (case when "user_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "user_id" end)
(case when "provider_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "provider_id" end)
(case when "entity_schema_plugin_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "entity_schema_plugin_id" end)

ddl.where: "external_id" is not null and ("user_id" is null or "provider_id" is not null)

ddl.name: event_stream_work_dirty_idx
ddl.where: "completed_revision" is null or "dirty_from" is not null

columns.value: (case when "owner_user_id" is null then '0' else '1' || "owner_user_id" end)
(case when "relationship_schema_slug" = 'member-of' and "relationship_schema_plugin_id" is null then ("properties" ->> 'rank')::double precision end)

ddl.name: workflow_execution_cleanup_idx
ddl.where: "expired_at" is not null and "cleared_at" is null

ddl.name: automation_run_owner_check
ddl.value: ("plugin_id" is null and "plugin_revision_id" is null and "plugin_config_revision_id" is null) or ("plugin_id" is not null and "plugin_revision_id" is not null and "plugin_config_revision_id" is not null)

ddl.name: automation_run_stage_check
ddl.value: ("stage" = 'before' and "delivery" = 'policy' and "retry_policy" is null and "next_attempt_at" is null and "attempt_count" <= 1) or ("stage" = 'after' and "delivery" in ('required', 'async') and "retry_policy" is not null)

ddl.name: automation_run_live_script_check
ddl.value: "status" not in ('queued', 'running') or "sandbox_script_id" is not null

ddl.name: automation_run_attempt_state_check
ddl.value: "attempt_number" > 0 and (("status" = 'running' and "finished_at" is null) or ("status" in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "finished_at" is not null))

ddl.name: automation_trigger_kind_check
ddl.value: ("category" in ('request', 'change') and "resource_kind" in ('entity', 'event', 'relationship') and "operation" in ('create', 'update', 'delete', 'batch')) or ("category" = 'change' and "resource_kind" = 'provider-entity-import' and "operation" = 'complete') or ("category" = 'signal' and "resource_kind" = 'signal' and "operation" = 'emit')

ddl.name: automation_trigger_causation_check
ddl.value: "depth" >= 0 and "lane" in ('interactive', 'background') and "initiator_kind" in ('user', 'integration', 'system') and "source" in ('api', 'import', 'integration', 'bootstrap', 'provider-refresh', 'scheduler', 'automation') and ("source" <> 'automation' or ("parent_run_id" is not null and "parent_trigger_id" is not null and "depth" > 0))

ddl.name: automation_trigger_parent_check
ddl.value: "parent_run_id" is null or "parent_trigger_id" is not null

ddl.name: automation_trigger_payload_kind_check
ddl.value: "payload" is null or (jsonb_typeof("payload") = 'object' and ("payload"->>'category') is not distinct from "category" and ("payload"->>'resource') is not distinct from "resource_kind" and ("payload"->>'operation') is not distinct from "operation")

ddl.name: entity_enrichment_request_operation_check
ddl.value: ("operation" = 'population' and "level" in ('base', 'full') and "language" is null) or ("operation" = 'translation' and "level" is null and "language" is not null)

ddl.name: import_run_prepared_release_check
ddl.value: "prepared_release" is null or ("pins" is not null and ("plan" is null or "plan" = "prepared_release"->'plan'))

ddl.name: integration_owner_check
ddl.value: ("plugin_installation_id" is null and "provider" = 'data-json' and "lot" = 'sink') or ("plugin_installation_id" is not null and "provider" <> 'data-json')

ddl.name: mutation_receipt_scope_check
ddl.value: ("mutation_scope" = 'global' and "scope_user_id" is null) or ("mutation_scope" = 'user' and "scope_user_id" is not null and "owner_user_id" is not null)

ddl.name: notification_state_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'admitted' and "outcome" is null and "settled_at" is null) or ("state" = 'settled' and "outcome" is not null and "outcome" in ('accepted', 'partial', 'failed', 'unknown', 'not-sent') and "settled_at" is not null)

ddl.name: notification_request_check
ddl.value: jsonb_typeof("request") = 'object' and ("request" = '{"kind":"test"}'::jsonb or ("request" @> '{"kind":"message"}'::jsonb and "request" ? 'message' and jsonb_typeof("request"->'message') = 'string'))

ddl.name: notification_delivery_attempt_check
ddl.value: ("attempt_id" is null and "claimed_at" is null and "status" not in ('sending', 'accepted', 'unknown')) or ("attempt_id" is not null and "claimed_at" is not null and "status" <> 'queued')

ddl.name: notification_delivery_settlement_check
ddl.value: ("status" in ('queued', 'sending') and "settled_at" is null) or ("status" not in ('queued', 'sending') and "settled_at" is not null)

ddl.name: notification_delivery_reason_check
ddl.value: ("status" in ('queued', 'sending', 'accepted') and "reason" is null) or ("reason" is not null and (("status" = 'failed' and "reason" in ('preparation-failed', 'provider-rejected')) or ("status" = 'unknown' and "reason" = 'delivery-unknown') or ("status" = 'skipped' and "reason" in ('server-disabled', 'channel-disabled', 'channel-deleted', 'source-cancelled'))))

ddl.name: plugin_config_revision_scope_check
ddl.value: "owner_user_id" is not null or "plugin_installation_id" is null

ddl.name: plugin_config_revision_envelope_check
ddl.value: octet_length("nonce") = 12 and ("encrypted_payload" is null or octet_length("encrypted_payload") >= 16)

ddl.name: relationship_collection_rank_valid
ddl.value: "relationship_schema_slug" <> 'member-of' or "relationship_schema_plugin_id" is not null or coalesce(("user_id" is not null and jsonb_typeof("properties" -> 'rank') = 'number' and ("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric = trunc(("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric) and abs(("properties" ->> 'rank')::numeric) < 4503599627370496), false)

ddl.name: reminder_schedule_check
ddl.value: "state" not in ('scheduled', 'processing') or ("due_at" is not null and "timezone" is not null and "entity_id" is not null and "reconcile_at" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_inactive_schedule_check
ddl.value: "state" <> 'needs-scheduling' or ("due_at" is null and "timezone" is null and "original_schedule" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_processing_check
ddl.value: "state" <> 'processing' or ("processing_at" is not null and "formatter_run_id" is not null and "trigger_id" is not null and "dispatch" is not null and "reconcile_at" is not null)

ddl.name: reminder_outcome_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'settled' and "outcome" in ('accepted', 'partial', 'failed', 'unknown', 'not-sent') and "outcome" is not null and "settled_at" is not null) or ("state" <> 'settled' and "outcome" is null)

ddl.name: reminder_content_check
ddl.value: ("removed_at" is null and "message" is not null and length(btrim("message")) between 1 and 4000 and "entity_title" is not null) or ("removed_at" is not null and "state" in ('settled', 'cancelled') and "message" is null and "entity_title" is null and "original_schedule" is null)

ddl.name: user_preferences_check
ddl.value:
jsonb_typeof("preferences") = 'object'
		and "preferences" ?& array['disableIntegrations', 'language', 'reportingTimeZone']
		and "preferences" - 'disableIntegrations' - 'language' - 'reportingTimeZone' = '{}'::jsonb
		and jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'disableIntegrations') = 'boolean'
		and jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'reportingTimeZone') = 'string'
		and "preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone' <> ''
		and btrim("preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone') = "preferences"->>'reportingTimeZone'
		and (
			jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'language') = 'null'
			or (jsonb_typeof("preferences"->'language') = 'string'
				and "preferences"->>'language' <> ''
				and btrim("preferences"->>'language', E' 	
') = "preferences"->>'language')
		)

ddl.name: global_calendar_source
ddl.definition:
select d.id, r.plugin_id, g.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.query, d.subject, d.start_at, d.precision, d.caption, d.art, d.done
			from definition_calendar_source d
			join plugin_revision r on r.id = d.plugin_revision_id
			join (
 select p.id as plugin_id, p.package_id, p.active_revision_id, p.environment_config_revision_id as config_revision_id, coalesce(c.owner_user_id is null and c.encrypted_payload is not null, false) as is_executable
	from plugin p
	left join plugin_config_revision c on c.id = p.environment_config_revision_id
	where p.owner_user_id is null and p.status = 'active'
) g on g.plugin_id = r.plugin_id and g.active_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id

ddl.name: global_entity_schema
ddl.definition:
select d.id, r.plugin_id, g.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.properties_schema, d.user_state, d.editor, d.browse, d.merge_identity_properties
			from definition_entity_schema d
			left join plugin_revision r on r.id = d.plugin_revision_id
			left join (
 select p.id as plugin_id, p.package_id, p.active_revision_id, p.environment_config_revision_id as config_revision_id, coalesce(c.owner_user_id is null and c.encrypted_payload is not null, false) as is_executable
	from plugin p
	left join plugin_config_revision c on c.id = p.environment_config_revision_id
	where p.owner_user_id is null and p.status = 'active'
) g on g.plugin_id = r.plugin_id and g.active_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null or g.plugin_id is not null

ddl.name: global_event_schema
ddl.definition:
select v.id, v.entity_schema_id, e.slug as entity_schema_slug, e.plugin_id, e.package_id, e.plugin_revision_id, v.slug, v.name, v.position, v.properties_schema, v.projection, v.event_group
			from "global_entity_schema" e
			join definition_event_schema v on v.entity_schema_id = e.id

ddl.name: global_plugin
ddl.definition:
select p.id as plugin_id, p.package_id, p.active_revision_id, p.environment_config_revision_id as config_revision_id, coalesce(c.owner_user_id is null and c.encrypted_payload is not null, false) as is_executable
	from plugin p
	left join plugin_config_revision c on c.id = p.environment_config_revision_id
	where p.owner_user_id is null and p.status = 'active'

ddl.name: global_relationship_schema
ddl.definition:
select d.id, r.plugin_id, g.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.source_entity_schema_slug, d.target_entity_schema_slug, d.properties_schema, d.user_write_policy, d.projection
			from definition_relationship_schema d
			left join plugin_revision r on r.id = d.plugin_revision_id
			left join "global_plugin" g on g.plugin_id = r.plugin_id and g.active_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null or g.plugin_id is not null

ddl.name: global_saved_view
ddl.definition:
select d.id, r.plugin_id, g.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.sort_order, d.data_sources, d.settings, d.renderer
			from definition_saved_view d
			left join plugin_revision r on r.id = d.plugin_revision_id
			left join "global_plugin" g on g.plugin_id = r.plugin_id and g.active_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null or g.plugin_id is not null

ddl.name: global_signal_schema
ddl.definition:
select d.id, r.plugin_id, g.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.notification_hook_slug, d.properties_schema, d.audience_policy, d.catalog_state
			from definition_signal_schema d
			left join plugin_revision r on r.id = d.plugin_revision_id
			left join "global_plugin" g on g.plugin_id = r.plugin_id and g.active_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null or g.plugin_id is not null

ddl.name: user_calendar_source_effective
ddl.definition:
select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope as plugin_scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.query, d.subject, d.start_at, d.precision, d.caption, d.art, d.done, p.is_definition_effective as is_effective, coalesce(o.is_hidden, false) as is_hidden
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_calendar_source d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			left join "calendar_source_override" o on o.user_id = p.user_id and o.plugin_id = p.plugin_id and o.slug = d.slug
			where p.is_listed

ddl.name: user_entity_schema
ddl.definition:
select u.id as user_id, d.id, null::text as plugin_id, null::text as package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, null::text as plugin_scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.properties_schema, d.user_state, d.editor, d.browse, d.merge_identity_properties, true as is_effective
			from definition_entity_schema d
			cross join "user" u
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null
			union all
			select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.properties_schema, d.user_state, d.editor, d.browse, d.merge_identity_properties, p.is_definition_effective
			from "user_plugin_state" p
			join definition_entity_schema d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			where p.is_present and p.is_listed

ddl.name: user_event_schema
ddl.definition:
select e.user_id, v.id, v.entity_schema_id, e.slug as entity_schema_slug, e.plugin_id, e.package_id, e.plugin_revision_id, v.slug, v.name, v.position, v.properties_schema, v.projection, e.is_effective, v.event_group
			from "user_entity_schema" e
			join definition_event_schema v on v.entity_schema_id = e.id

ddl.name: user_import_source
ddl.definition:
select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope as plugin_scope, p.installation_id, p.config_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.description, d.position, d.workflow_slug, s.id as workflow_script_id, d.input_schema, d.required_plugin_config_keys, d.export_help, d.plan
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_import_source d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			left join sandbox_script s on s.plugin_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id and s.slug = d.workflow_script_slug
			where p.is_executable
			union all
			select u.id, 'kernel:data-json:' || u.id, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, 'data-json', 'Data import', 'Import generic entities, relationships, and events from JSON.', 0, 'data-json', null::text, '{"unknownKeys":"strict","fields":{"submissionKey":{"type":"string","label":"Submission key","description":"Optional key to reuse the same run when retrying this submission."},"uploadToken":{"type":"string","label":"JSON file","validation":{"required":true},"description":"A Ryot data document using existing schemas.","format":{"kind":"upload","allowedFileExtensions":["json"]}}}}'::jsonb, '{}'::text[], null::jsonb, null::jsonb
			from "user" u

ddl.name: user_integration_provider
ddl.definition:
select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope as plugin_scope, p.installation_id, p.config_revision_id, d.slug, d.name, d.description, d.position, d.lot, d.script_slug, s.id as script_id, d.settings_schema, d.requires_pro_key, d.supports_ownership_sync, d.plan
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_integration_provider d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			left join sandbox_script s on s.plugin_revision_id = d.plugin_revision_id and s.slug = d.script_slug
			where p.is_executable
			union all
			select u.id, 'kernel:data-json:' || u.id, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, null::text, 'data-json', 'Data webhook', 'Receive generic entities, relationships, and events as JSON.', 0, 'sink', null::text, null::text, '{"fields":{},"unknownKeys":"strict"}'::jsonb, false, false, null::jsonb
			from "user" u

ddl.name: user_plugin
ddl.definition:
select user_id, plugin_id, package_id, installation_id, scope, owner_user_id, active_revision_id, config_revision_id, health, is_hidden, sort_order, is_listed, is_definition_effective, is_executable
			from "user_plugin_state"
			where is_present

ddl.name: user_relationship_schema
ddl.definition:
select u.id as user_id, d.id, null::text as plugin_id, null::text as package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, null::text as plugin_scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.source_entity_schema_slug, d.target_entity_schema_slug, d.properties_schema, true as is_effective, d.user_write_policy, d.projection
			from definition_relationship_schema d
			cross join "user" u
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null
			union all
			select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.source_entity_schema_slug, d.target_entity_schema_slug, d.properties_schema, p.is_definition_effective and (d.source_entity_schema_slug is null or exists (select 1 from definition_entity_schema e where e.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and e.slug = d.source_entity_schema_slug)) and (d.target_entity_schema_slug is null or exists (select 1 from definition_entity_schema e where e.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and e.slug = d.target_entity_schema_slug)), d.user_write_policy, d.projection
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_relationship_schema d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			where p.is_listed and (d.source_entity_schema_slug is null or exists (select 1 from definition_entity_schema e where e.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and e.slug = d.source_entity_schema_slug)) and (d.target_entity_schema_slug is null or exists (select 1 from definition_entity_schema e where e.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and e.slug = d.target_entity_schema_slug))

ddl.name: user_sandbox_provider
ddl.definition:
select p.user_id, s.id, s.plugin_id, p.package_id, p.scope as plugin_scope, p.installation_id, s.slug, s.name, s.root_entity_schema_slug, s.information, s.created_at, s.updated_at
			from "user_plugin" p
			join sandbox_provider s on s.plugin_id = p.plugin_id
			join definition_provider d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and d.slug = s.slug and d.root_entity_schema_slug = s.root_entity_schema_slug
			where p.is_executable and exists (select 1 from definition_entity_schema e where e.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and e.slug = s.root_entity_schema_slug)

ddl.name: user_sandbox_provider_operation
ddl.definition:
select provider.user_id, provider.id as provider_id, provider.plugin_id, provider.package_id,
			operation.operation,
			case when operation.operation = 'search' then script.metadata -> 'searchOptionsSchema' else null end as options_schema
		from "user_sandbox_provider" provider
		join plugin p on p.id = provider.plugin_id
		join definition_provider_operation operation on operation.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id and operation.provider_slug = provider.slug
		join sandbox_script script on script.plugin_revision_id = operation.plugin_revision_id
			and script.slug = operation.script_slug and script.provider_id = provider.id
			and script.metadata ->> 'kind' = 'provider'
			and script.metadata ->> 'providerOperation' = operation.operation

ddl.name: user_saved_view
ddl.definition:
select u.id as user_id, d.id, null::text as plugin_id, null::text as package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, null::text as plugin_scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.sort_order, d.data_sources, d.settings, d.renderer, true as is_effective
			from definition_saved_view d
			cross join "user" u
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null
			union all
			select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.icon, d.sort_order, d.data_sources, d.settings, d.renderer, p.is_definition_effective
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_saved_view d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			where p.is_listed

ddl.name: user_saved_view_effective
ddl.definition:
select s.id, null::text as plugin_id, custom_plugin.package_id,
		s.user_id, s.slug, s.name, s.icon, s.plugin_installation_id,
		s.revision, s.sort_order, s.data_sources, false as is_builtin,
		s.is_hidden, s.renderer, s.created_at, s.settings, s.updated_at
	from "saved_view" s
	left join "plugin_installation" custom_installation on custom_installation.id = s.plugin_installation_id
	left join "plugin" custom_plugin on custom_plugin.id = custom_installation.plugin_id
	union all
	select 'builtin:' || char_length(d.user_id)::text || ':' || d.user_id || char_length(case when d.plugin_id is null then 'kernel' else 'plugin' end)::text || ':' || case when d.plugin_id is null then 'kernel' else 'plugin' end || char_length(coalesce(d.plugin_id, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(d.plugin_id, '') || char_length(d.slug)::text || ':' || d.slug as id, d.plugin_id, d.package_id,
		d.user_id, d.slug, d.name, d.icon, p.installation_id as plugin_installation_id,
		hashtext(d.id || ':' || coalesce(o.revision, 0)::text) as revision,
		coalesce(o.sort_order, d.sort_order) as sort_order, d.data_sources, true as is_builtin,
		coalesce(o.is_hidden, false) as is_hidden, d.renderer,
		null::timestamptz as created_at, d.settings, null::timestamptz as updated_at
	from "user_saved_view" d
	left join "user_plugin" p on p.user_id = d.user_id and p.plugin_id = d.plugin_id
	left join "saved_view_override" o on o.user_id = d.user_id and o.slug = d.slug
		and o.plugin_id is not distinct from d.plugin_id

ddl.name: user_signal_schema
ddl.definition:
select u.id as user_id, d.id, null::text as plugin_id, null::text as package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, null::text as plugin_scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.notification_hook_slug, d.properties_schema, d.audience_policy, d.catalog_state, true as is_effective
			from definition_signal_schema d
			cross join "user" u
			where d.plugin_revision_id is null
			union all
			select p.user_id, d.id, p.plugin_id, p.package_id, d.plugin_revision_id, p.scope, d.slug, d.name, d.position, d.notification_hook_slug, d.properties_schema, d.audience_policy, d.catalog_state, p.is_definition_effective and (d.audience_policy ->> 'kind' <> 'related_users' or exists (select 1 from "user_relationship_schema" r where r.user_id = p.user_id and r.plugin_id = p.plugin_id and r.slug = d.audience_policy ->> 'relationshipSchemaSlug' and r.is_effective))
			from "user_plugin" p
			join definition_signal_schema d on d.plugin_revision_id = p.active_revision_id
			where p.is_listed and (d.audience_policy ->> 'kind' <> 'related_users' or exists (select 1 from "user_relationship_schema" r where r.user_id = p.user_id and r.plugin_id = p.plugin_id and r.slug = d.audience_policy ->> 'relationshipSchemaSlug'))
